name.value: Emotional Faces Interference Task: Threat Low > Threat High

value: During attentional control, we observed engagement of VMPFC/rACC, PCC, and IPL when threat interference was high (perceptual load was low) compared to when threat interference was low (perceptual load was high) (i.e., Threat Low > Threat High).

spans.text: During attentional control, we observed engagement of VMPFC/rACC, PCC, and IPL when threat interference was high (perceptual load was low) compared to when threat interference was low (perceptual load was high) (i.e., Threat Low > Threat High).

Whole-brain findings for Threat Low > Threat High revealed engagement of the left VMPFC encompassing rostral ACC (rACC; peak MNI coordinates: − 2, 52, − 2; Z = 5.45; volume = 5752 mm 3 ; p < 0.05 FWE corrected), left posterior cingulate cortex (PCC; peak MNI coordinates: − 8, − 46, 32; Z = 5.24; volume = 1248 mm 3 ; p < 0.05 FWE corrected), and left inferior parietal lobe (IPL; peak MNI coordinates: − 44, − 72, 38; Z = 4.93, volume = 1008 mm 3 ; p < 0.05 FWE corrected).
Our primary contrast of interest was Threat Low > Threat High perceptual load

value: During cognitive reappraisal of negative images compared to naturally experiencing emotions evoked by negative images (i.e., Reappraise > Look-Negative), we observed recruitment of DLPFC, VLPFC, DMPFC, temporal regions, parahippocampal gyrus , and cerebellar activations.

spans.text: During cognitive reappraisal of negative images compared to naturally experiencing emotions evoked by negative images (i.e., Reappraise > Look-Negative), we observed recruitment of DLPFC, VLPFC, DMPFC, temporal regions, parahippocampal gyrus , and cerebellar activations.

Whole-brain findings for Reappraise > Look-Negative revealed recruitment of the left DLPFC (peak MNI coordinates: − 42, 12, 60; Z = 5.89; volume = 2464 mm 3 ; p < 0.05 FWE corrected), right DLPFC (peak MNI coordinates: 18, 40, 56; Z = 5.23; volume = 1408 mm 3 ; p < 0.05 FWE corrected), left VLPFC (peak MNI coordinates: − 50, 22, 12 & − 46, 36, − 10; Z = 4.70 & 4.59; volume = 672 mm 3 & 480 mm 3 ; p < 0.05 FWE corrected) right VLPFC (peak MNI coordinates: 40, 34, − 16; Z = 4.95; volume = 800 mm 3 ; p < 0.05 FWE corrected), and a cluster spanning the left supplementary motor cortex and DMPFC (peak MNI coordinates: − 6, 16, 64, Z = 5.56, volume = 4136 mm 3 , p < 0.05 FWE corrected).

source_definition.value: Perceptual load was manipulated with letter strings: low load consisted entirely of target letters, whereas high load consisted of one target letter embedded among five non-target consonants.

spans.text: For ERT, blocks of Reappraise, Look-Negative, and Look-Neutral were modeled separately

model_settings.value: Voxel-wise whole-brain general linear models were fitted separately for each task. Regressors were convolved with the canonical hemodynamic response function and modeled with a 128 s high-pass filter. EFIT included separate regressors for angry-low, angry-high, fearful-low, fearful-high, neutral-low, and neutral-high blocks; fearful and angry conditions were combined as threat for the primary contrast. ERT modeled Reappraise, Look-Negative, and Look-Neutral blocks relative to fixation baseline. Motion realignment parameters, age, and gender were controlled as nuisance covariates in the reported analyses.
